The '''Sextuna Mining Corporation''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company based on [[Blaudu Sextus]]. The company employed the use of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]], pacifist [[Octusi]] [[Slavery/Legends|servants]] from neigboring [[Blaudu Octus]]. When [[Freedom Flight]] convinced the Octusi to [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]] against their masters in [[44 ABY]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] feared that the uprising would help fuel other such revolts throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], shattering the stability of the government. As such, she sent funds through the Sextuna Mining Corporation to hire [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to put down the revolt.
